summary: OpenAI's Codex Open Source Fund is a $1 million initiative awarding grants of up to $25,000 in API credits to open-source projects that use Codex CLI and other OpenAI models. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis via the official form; the fund also underpins the separate Codex for Open Source program for maintainers.
claim_steps: Confirm your project is open source and uses (or will use) Codex CLI / OpenAI models.
Fill out the application form at openai.com/form/codex-open-source-fund/ — name, email, LinkedIn, GitHub, the project you represent, and how you'd use API credits.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; grants are up to $25,000 in API credits at OpenAI's discretion.
